title: std1 UI check
description: A test for core-ar2 0.17's UI and system events on the Analog Rytm MKII: a std1 mod that subscribes to ev_boot_done, ev_idle, ev_crash, ev_usb, ev_key_leds, ev_mode, ev_param_set, ev_clip, ev_pattern, ev_mute and ev_view and records what each passes in ui_check (ui.c); while armed (UI TEST in SETTINGS) it takes every mute and every pattern clear and sets one LED with core_led_set; UI CRASH, while armed, raises an illegal instruction for ev_crash.
